# Copley Hydro Jetting Pros

> Copley's neighborhood plan distinguishes Montrose's commercial development from residential allotments and open parcels elsewhere in the township. For each request, confirm the building's wastewater connection and the person responsible for the private line rather than assuming one system serves all of Copley.
